dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: It's really more like a collection of my personal memories...

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: ...Of the fox in the moonlight, of the giant skeleton in the wild that tried to pluck the moon to use as its eye...

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: ...Of the winds of winter, the long journey of the gods...
